cohort: The study included 321 women (107 cases and 214 controls) who were pregnant or postpartum (<=6 weeks) with confirmed VTE (cases) or matched on gestational stage (controls) from Muhimbili National Hospital.
finding: Independent predictors of PA-VTE were a history of VTE, gross varicose veins, and stillbirth, with a notably low uptake of antenatal thromboprophylaxis among the study population.
